links.outcome: Readability of chatbot STD responses versus 6th-grade patient education standard
links.effect: None of the chatbots achieved the 6th-grade readability standard; all generated information too complex for the general public, especially those with lower health literacy.
links.quote: However, results showed that none of the chatbots achieved the 6th-grade readability standard.

links.outcome: Reading level of chatbot-generated STD information relative to recommended level
links.effect: None of the four chatbots met the 6th-grade readability benchmark across six readability metrics; text too complex for lower health literacy.
links.quote: All the chatbots generated information that was too complex for the general public, especially for individuals with lower health literacy levels.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots on reliability and readability benchmarks for sexually transmitted disease information without testing a deployment practice or guardrail.
